title: Shared definitions for consumer-compliance-fair-lending skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline. Plugin-specific extras (udaap_element_enum, fair_lending_test_type_enum, protected_class_enum, legal_privilege_posture_enum) sit alongside the base definitions; they show up across udaap-risk-review, fair-lending-test-plan, complaint-theme-analysis.

severity_enum.description: Standard four-step severity ladder. UDAAP element severities and fair-lending disparity ratings use this scale.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by audit findings and exam-letter ingestion (CFPB, OCC, FRB, FDIC, state regulators) where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'Chief Compliance Officer', 'Head of Fair Lending', 'Head of Consumer Compliance', 'General Counsel', 'Fair Lending Officer'). Never an individual person.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common consumer-compliance gates: legal-privilege posture confirmation, pre-launch UDAAP gate, fair-lending test-plan approval, redlining-analysis sign-off, complaint-theme escalation.

udaap_element_enum.description: Dodd-Frank §1031 element finding for a UDAAP review. 'none-found' is a positive finding when the element was specifically considered and ruled out.

fair_lending_test_type_enum.description: Type of fair-lending test in a test plan. Drives data-element requirements, control-population definitions, and statistical methodology.

protected_class_enum.description: Protected class under ECOA / Reg B / FHA / state law. Source-of-income, sexual-orientation, and gender-identity are state- and city-specific; their inclusion depends on jurisdiction.

legal_privilege_posture_enum.description: Legal privilege posture for the artifact. UDAAP review memos and fair-lending test results commonly carry privilege; the posture must be set explicitly and confirmed by counsel before distribution.
